_how_to: Ready-made messages in the chat (💌 button and the quick row above the keyboard). Edit freely: each category has an id, a name, an emoji and its messages, and an optional weight (default 1): a category with weight 4 is 4 times as likely to show up in the quick row and in Surprise me, and its tab comes first. Short ones (under ~46 characters) also show up as one-tap quick messages.
